name: doncoin
description: DONCOIN — full-stack monorepo (React + Vite client, Express + TypeScript server)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:mock: concurrently -k -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:mock -w server" "npm run dev:mock -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.vercel-build: npm run db:generate -w server && npm run build -w client
